findings.action: Annotate boundaries in review recordings before training a supervised detector.
findings.evidence: Fusion marks 4 of 15 evidence-covered 2026 recordings and 3 of 10 evidence-covered 2023 recordings for review.
findings.interpretation: Signal, correlation, and DTW provide a smaller review queue, not verified lap labels.
findings.title: Recurrence evidence narrows manual review

findings.action: Retest DTW against manually labeled lap pairs and unrelated hard negatives.
findings.evidence: Held-out match rates are 50.0% for 2026 and 70.0% for 2023.
findings.interpretation: DTW uses signal-derived periods, so agreement cannot count as independent confirmation.
findings.title: DTW support is cohort-dependent and teacher-dependent

findings.action: Use interpolation only below a validated gap limit and retain an imputation mask.
findings.evidence: Best short-gap median normalized RMSE is 0.20 for 2026 and 0.54 for 2023; 0.5 s gaps rise to 0.30 and 2.45.
findings.interpretation: Interior interpolation can repair isolated samples but cannot create missing dynamics or timing truth.
findings.title: Interpolation repairs short gaps only

findings.action: Do not use these embeddings as pseudo-labels; redesign objectives and hard-negative sampling first.
findings.evidence: Effective rank is 1.03 of 8 dimensions for 2026 and 1.03 of 8 for 2023.
findings.interpretation: Near-unity neighbor similarities do not demonstrate useful recurrence structure when almost all variance occupies one direction.
findings.title: Masked-reconstruction embeddings collapse

findings.action: Keep PCA as baseline; revisit autoencoders only with a task-linked validation target.
findings.evidence: Test MSE ratios versus PCA are 1.28 for 2026 and 1.03 for 2023; values above 1 are worse.
findings.interpretation: Nonlinear reconstruction adds no demonstrated value at current model size and training setup.
findings.title: Autoencoder fails to beat PCA

findings.action: Do not promote GRU residuals to labels. Change horizon or objective before retraining.
findings.evidence: Test MSE ratios versus persistence are 1.91 for 2026 and 7.81 for 2023.
findings.interpretation: Slowly sampled telemetry makes unchanged-value prediction a strong baseline; current GRU adds error.
findings.title: GRU fails to beat persistence

findings.action: Use regimes to stratify future labels and error analysis.
findings.evidence: Training selects k=3 with silhouette 0.862 for 2026 and 0.667 for 2023; seed ARI is 1.000 and 1.000.
findings.interpretation: Clusters are reproducible operating regimes, not lap phases or track sectors.
findings.title: Three stable operating regimes appear in both cohorts

findings.action: Fuse evidence by method family and preserve disagreement instead of averaging all scores.
findings.evidence: Strongest recording correlations are Autoencoder–Sequence at rho=0.97 for 2026 and Autoencoder–Sequence at rho=0.95 for 2023.
findings.interpretation: Correlated reconstruction and sequence errors reflect shared signal difficulty, not independent lap agreement.
findings.title: Strong method correlations mostly expose shared behavior

limitations: No independent lap boundaries, start-line beacon, GPS position, or official timing truth are present.
2023 elapsed time is inferred from validated 20 Hz sampling because source time cells are blank.
2026 timestamps are regular at 10 Hz; interpolation adds no higher-frequency information.
DTW depends on signal-derived candidate periods, and learned-method windows overlap.
Stable clusters identify operating regimes only.
next_actions: Review and label boundaries in the seven fusion-selected recordings.
Record lap beacon or GPS truth during the next event.
Evaluate boundary error, lap-count error, precision, and recall on recording-level held-out splits.
Keep PCA and persistence as mandatory baselines.
Retain interpolation masks and reject gaps beyond validated limits.
